name: cnt
eval: (() => { const t = window.__demo.trees; const seen = new Set(); for (const m of t.children) { if (!m.isInstancedMesh) continue; const a = m.instanceMatrix.array; for (let i = 0; i < m.count; i++) seen.add(Math.round(a[i*16+12])+','+Math.round(a[i*16+14])); } const pts = [...seen].map(k=>k.split(',').map(Number)); const box=(r0,r1)=>pts.filter(([x,z])=>{const d=Math.hypot(x,z-12);return d>=r0&&d<r1;}).length; return { total: pts.length, inner: box(0,170), outer: box(240,400) }; })()
